run_preprocess_cli: run the preprocess CLI to convert AMASS motion data into pickle files for motion prediction
run_split_into_windows: run split_into_windows to split a motion object into fixed-size windows with a given stride
run_process_split: run process_split to process a list of motion files into source and target numpy arrays
run_process_file: run process_file to load a single AMASS motion file and extract source and target sequences
run_read_content: run read_content to read a text file line by line and return a list of stripped lines
